trl_rationale: Subsystem hardware assembled in the vacuum facility but its thermal-vacuum testing is still planned. A subscale proof-of-concept radiator was built and tested.

evidence.quote: The panel was tested at water temperatures ranging from 330 to 400 K and a sink temperature of 190 K.
The affordable design was shown to increase heat rejection per unit mass compared to the Second Generation Radiator Demonstration Unit at a fraction of the cost.
All components have been mounted to the Technology Demonstration Unit structural elements and have been assembled in the Vacuum Facility 6 test chamber at Glenn.
